purpose: Verdicts from reviewing every root pair that etymology.js matches by prefix. Keep this so a rebuild only has to review pairs that are new, rather than all of them again.
reviewed_against_dump: enwiktionary-latest-pages-articles.xml.bz2, 2026-08-04 (two review rounds: 879 pairs, then 118 after the parser was widened)
note: The unrelated pairs must match UNRELATED_PREFIX_PAIRS in etymology.js. Pairs are [language, shorter root, longer root, related]. Roots are lowercased with diacritics and affix hyphens removed, as compared.
